The '''Sarlacc Project campaign''' was a campaign carried out by the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] to discover the nature of and stop [[Sarlacc Project]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] secret construction of a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]].
